system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global geomorphometric topographic position index coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m topographic position index dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric topographic position index tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only
data_description.records: 1148 spatial topographic position index tiles in collection

band_semantics.b1: Topographic Position Index (TPI) raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Positive values indicate ridges/hilltops, negative values indicate valleys, near-zero values indicate flat areas or mid-slopes.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial topographic position index tiles, not as a dated time series.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Topographic Position Index values representing the difference between a cell's elevation and the mean elevation of its neighborhood; positive values indicate higher positions (ridges), negative values indicate lower positions (valleys).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
